sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“百分之九十九隐形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Articles of Interest is a show about what we wear.
sentences.zh: 《衣着有信》是一档关于我们所穿衣物的节目。

sentences.en: For its first two seasons, it existed nestled warmly within the 99% Invisible neSt.
sentences.zh: 在前两季里，它一直温热地依偎在“百分之九十九隐形”的巢穴中。

sentences.en: But for season three, host and producer Avery Truffleman has taken it to new heights
sentences.zh: 但到了第三季，主持兼制作人埃弗里·特拉夫曼将其带到了新的高度，

sentences.en: as a completely independent production, and I couldn't be more pleased and proud.
sentences.zh: 成为了一档完全独立的节目，我感到无比高兴和骄傲。

sentences.en: This is the only episode of Articles of Interest that we will feature,
sentences.zh: 这是我们将播出的唯一一期《衣着有信》，

sentences.en: so you have to search for Articles of Interest in your favorite podcast app
sentences.zh: 所以你得在自己喜欢的播客应用中搜索《衣着有信》，

sentences.en: and subscribe to get the rest of the story,
sentences.zh: 并订阅以收听故事的剩余部分，

sentences.en: which is a season-long investigation into a particular look that has come back in style
sentences.zh: 这是一场历时一季的调查，探究了一种不断回归潮流的特定造型，

sentences.en: again and again and again, and Avery is going to find out why.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次，而埃弗里要找出原因。

sentences.en: It is a great honor to present to you Avery Truffleman's Articles of IntereSt.
sentences.zh: 很荣幸向大家呈献埃弗里·特拉夫曼的《衣着有信》。

sentences.en: Once upon a time, six years ago, I was given a glimpse of the future.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，在六年前，我有幸窥见了未来。

sentences.en: But that future is now the past, so at this point, you've seen it too.
sentences.zh: 但那个未来现在已成过去，所以此时此刻，你们也见过了。

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: So these are jeans for 2018.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是2018年的牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: In 2016, I was allowed to see what blue jeans would look like in 2018
sentences.zh: 在2016年，我得以一窥2018年的牛仔裤会长什么样，

sentences.en: because I was at the office of WGSN,
sentences.zh: 因为我当时在WGSN的办公室，

sentences.en: perhaps the world's largest trend forecasting company.
sentences.zh: 这或许是全球最大的潮流预测公司。

sentences.en: Almost every major brand and retailer consults them.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有主流品牌和零售商都向他们咨询。

sentences.en: And they're subscribing to us to kind of get a projection of what to expect
sentences.zh: 他们订阅我们是为了大致了解未来两年内，

sentences.en: in consumer patterns and changes over the next two years.
sentences.zh: 消费者模式和变化会有怎样的预期。

sentences.en: And it was so exciting that trend forecaster Sarah Owen would let me look at WGSN's website
sentences.zh: 潮流预测师萨拉·欧文能让我查看WGSN的网站来了解未来的牛仔裤，这太让人兴奋了，

sentences.en: to see the jeans of the future,
sentences.zh: 因为通常WGSN要收数千美元才让人看他们的预测。

sentences.en: because normally WGSN charges thousands of dollars to look at their predictions.
sentences.zh: WGSN代表什么？

sentences.en: What does WGSN stand for?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我不确定，因为我知道我们经历过一些品牌重塑，

sentences.en: This is why I'm not sure whether, because I know we went through some rebranding
sentences.zh: 它有点变成了一个其实没什么实际意义的缩写。

sentences.en: and it's kind of become an acronym that doesn't really have a meaning.
sentences.zh: 所以那都是关于我在2016年做的一篇关于WGSN的报道。

sentences.en: So that was all from a story I did about WGSN in 2016.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我对这家公司就有点着迷了。

sentences.en: And ever since, I've been mildly obsessed with this company.
sentences.zh: 它给我的感觉，有点像小时候有人告诉我什么是性时的感觉。

sentences.en: It kind of gave me the same feeling as when I was a kid and someone told me what sex was.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，所有热都在做这个吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, is everybody doing this?
sentences.zh: 它无处不在吗？

sentences.en: Is it everywhere?
sentences.zh: 但怎么没人谈论它呢？

sentences.en: But no one is talking about it?
sentences.zh: 就WGSN而言，结果证明，呃，差不多吧。

sentences.en: In the case of WGSN, it turns out, like, yeah, kind of.
sentences.zh: 有这么多的公司都在使用WGSN。

sentences.en: So many companies do use WGSN.
sentences.zh: 随着我做了越来越多的服装和时尚报道，

sentences.en: And as I did more and more stories about clothes and fashion,
sentences.zh: 我开始问我采访过的每一个人，他们是否咨询过这家公司。

sentences.en: I started asking everyone I spoke to whether or not they consulted it.
sentences.zh: 甚至连一家生产夏威夷衬衫的公司的男装总监也问过。

sentences.en: Even this director of menswear at a company that makes Hawaiian shirts.
sentences.zh: 你们用WGSN吗？

sentences.en: Do you use WGSN?
sentences.zh: 你看，这家公司生产阿罗哈衬衫。

sentences.en: Like, this company makes Aloha shirts.
sentences.zh: 指令似乎相当明确。

sentences.en: The directive seems pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道阿罗哈衬衫应该是什么样的。

sentences.en: We all know what Aloha shirts are supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 但这家公司的设计部门在看到服装廓形发生变化时，

sentences.en: But the design department of this company wants reassurance and a second opinion
sentences.zh: 还是希望得到确认和第二种意见。

sentences.en: when they're seeing silhouettes shift.
sentences.zh: 现在正在发生巨大的转变，因为以前都是巨大的宽松衬衫，对吧？

sentences.en: There's a big shift happening now because it was huge boxy shirts, right?
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况持续了很长时间。

sentences.en: And that was the norm for a long time.
sentences.zh: 然后它开始变得更小、更修身。

sentences.en: And it started to get smaller and trimmer fit.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始收窄版型。

sentences.en: So we started to bring our fits in.
sentences.zh: 但现在它正朝相反的方向转变，再次变得宽大和oversized。

sentences.en: But now it's shifting the other way and becoming boxy and oversized again.
sentences.zh: 所以当然，万物皆有周期。

sentences.en: So sure, everything's a cycle.
sentences.zh: 这是老生常谈了。

sentences.en: That's a truism.
sentences.zh: 但自从我了解了WGSN后，我就不禁好奇预测师在潮流周期中扮演什么角色。

sentences.en: But once I learned about WGSN, I couldn't help but wonder the role that forecasters play in the trend cycle.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果每家公司都在咨询WGSN，那是不是WGSN在创造潮流？

sentences.en: Like, if every company is consulting WGSN, is WGSN creating the trends?
sentences.zh: 然后人们买这些潮流只是因为它们存在？

sentences.en: And then do people buy the trends just because they're there?
sentences.zh: 这会不会是尾巴摇狗？

sentences.en: Is the tail wagging the dog?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有这么多人订阅WGSN。

sentences.en: I mean, so many people subscribe to WGSN.
sentences.zh: 如果你说，你知道的，透明塑料饰钉将在2018年流行，人们可能会使用它们。

sentences.en: If you said, you know, clear plastic studs are going to be in style in, you know, 2018, people would probably use them.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会告诉你其中有多少比例。

sentences.en: And then we'd let you know how much of it.
sentences.zh: 对，先有鸡还是先有蛋。

sentences.en: Yeah, the chicken or the egg.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，这总是很难回答，因为正如我所说，世界上一些最具影响力和辨识度的品牌确实在使用我们。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's always a hard one because, like I said, we do have some of the most influential and recognizable brands in the world using us.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们给他们提供那种洞察和信息，让他们去做某种潮流，这就成了：是我们创造的，还是它其实本来就要实现了？

sentences.en: So if we are giving them that insight and information that they should be doing a certain trend, it's like, did we create it or was it actually about to come to fruition?
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我想要直接收尾的方式。

sentences.en: So that's how I wanted to, like, directly end.
sentences.zh: 你会以为现在的我，在2022年作为未来人，会知道答案。

sentences.en: And you would think that I, now, in 2022, as a person of the future, would know the answer.
sentences.zh: 比如，到了这个时候，我本可以看出WGSN对2018年牛仔裤的预测是否准确。

sentences.en: Like, at this point, I could see if WGSN was right about the genes of 2018.
sentences.zh: 自从我做了那篇报道以来，经常有人问我看到了什么，未来的牛仔裤最终是否成了现实。

sentences.en: And ever since I did that story, I have periodically been asked what I saw, if the genes of the future ever came to be.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认，我完全忘光了。

sentences.en: And I have to admit that I absolutely forgot.
sentences.zh: 我一点也记不得了。

sentences.en: I don't remember at all.
sentences.zh: 因为，怎么说呢，在过去的六年里发生了很多其他的事情。

sentences.en: Because, I don't know, a bunch of other stuff came up in the last six years.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是2018年的牛仔裤。

sentences.en: So these are genes for 2018.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: So everyone's always like, were they right?
sentences.zh: 所以大家总会问，他们预测对了吗？

sentences.en: What are the genes of the future?
sentences.zh: 未来的基因是什么？

sentences.en: Do you remember?
sentences.zh: 你还记得吗？

sentences.en: Sarah Owen didn't remember the genes of the future either.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·欧文也不记得未来的基因是什么了。

sentences.en: I don't remember the visual we looked at, but I can definitely find out.
sentences.zh: 我不记得我们看过的那个视觉资料了，但我绝对能查到。

sentences.en: Sarah is not at WGSN anymore.
sentences.zh: 萨拉已经不在WGSN工作了。

sentences.en: She went on to found another company called Soon Future Studies, which takes more of an academic approach to future research.
sentences.zh: 她后来创立了一家名为“即时未来研究”的公司，对未来研究采取了更具学术性的方法。

sentences.en: Sarah will write up these long, comprehensive, multi-page, in-depth analyses about everything.
sentences.zh: 萨拉会就方方面面撰写长篇、全面、多页且深入的分析报告。

sentences.en: What I'll do and what we'll do on our team when we're looking at trends is we'll always look at it in a context of mega macro and micro.
sentences.zh: 我的做法以及我们团队在研究趋势时的做法，就是始终在宏观、中观和微观的背景下来看待它们。

sentences.en: Because that helps you differentiate between what's kind of a fad and what has longer legs and is really going to make a shift in the world.
sentences.zh: 因为这有助于你区分什么是昙花一现的时尚，什么具有更长的生命力并真正会给世界带来变革。

sentences.en: Trends often get talked about like fads, but trends and fads are different.
sentences.zh: 人们在谈论趋势时往往把它当成转瞬即逝的时尚，但趋势和时尚是不同的。

sentences.en: Trends are longer than fads.
sentences.zh: 趋势比时尚更持久。

sentences.en: Fads are often a look or a product or an idea that gets really popular in a small subset of the population.
sentences.zh: 时尚通常是一种外观、产品或理念，在小部分人群中变得非常流行。

sentences.en: They hit and then as quickly as they came, they go away.
sentences.zh: 它们迅速爆红，然后又以和来时一样快的速度消失。

sentences.en: But a trend has resonance because it hits the zeitgeiSt.
sentences.zh: 但趋势之所以有共鸣，是因为它击中了时代精神。

sentences.en: That's what Sarah Owens' true trend forecasting is all about.
sentences.zh: 这正是萨拉·欧文斯真正的趋势预测的核心所在。

sentences.en: Connecting micro trends like clothing to larger societal shifts, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 将服装等微观趋势与更大的社会变革联系起来，也就是

sentences.en: megatrends.
sentences.zh: 巨型趋势。

sentences.en: The mega framing of the world, which is decades long.
sentences.zh: 对世界的宏观框架界定，这通常长达数十年。

sentences.en: To me, that's really how you start to kind of talk about trends in the context of the time horizon they'll exist in.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这才是你如何开始在它们将存在的时间跨度背景下去探讨趋势的方式。

sentences.en: So do you want an actual trend report?
sentences.zh: 那么，你想要一份真正的趋势报告吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to know what the real megatrends are?
sentences.zh: 你想知道真正的巨型趋势是什么吗？

sentences.en: Here's your trend report.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的趋势报告。

sentences.en: We are seeing demographic polarization.
sentences.zh: 我们正在经历人口极化。

sentences.en: We are seeing increasing wealth inequality.
sentences.zh: 我们正在经历日益加剧的财富不平等。

sentences.en: We are seeing a weakening of global institutions.
sentences.zh: 我们正在看到全球机构的削弱。

sentences.en: We're seeing the climate crisis unfold.
sentences.zh: 我们正目睹气候危机展开。

sentences.en: And then there's also the mental health crisis.
sentences.zh: 还有心理健康危机。

sentences.en: I may be missing a couple and there's a lot more.
sentences.zh: 我可能漏掉了一两个，而且还有很多。

sentences.en: Aren't you worried about that?
sentences.zh: 难道你不为此担心吗？

sentences.en: I think a lot of people could look at your macro trends and be like, yeah, those are all the things that keep me up at night.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人看到你的宏观趋势可能会觉得，没错，这些都是让我夜不能寐的事情。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: In the sense that you're saying that the megatrends were so in it that they seem obvious.
sentences.zh: 就你是说巨型趋势如此深入其中，以至于它们看起来显而易见。

sentences.en: Is that what you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And especially if we're like, well, then what is this?
sentences.zh: 尤其是当我们觉得，好吧，那这到底是什么？

sentences.en: What is trend prediction?
sentences.zh: 什么是趋势预测？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, I think anyone can identify a trend, whether it's a mega macro or micro.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为任何人都能识别出趋势，无论是宏观、超宏观还是微观趋势。

sentences.en: What people can't do is tell the story or see the context of the marriage, of those trifecta coming together.
sentences.zh: 人们做不到的是讲述这三者结合的故事，或是看清它们联姻的背景。

sentences.en: So, yes, you could exist in today's current climate and feel the burden of the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你可能生活在当下的环境中，感受到气候危机的重压。

sentences.en: You could suffer from anxiety.
sentences.zh: 你可能会遭受焦虑的折磨。

sentences.en: You know, you can see and spot the megatrends, but can you understand the connections and the impact?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你能看到并发现超级趋势，但你能理解这些联系和影响吗？

sentences.en: But it's not saying that, oh, weakening global institutions means you're going to be wearing this kind of pattern.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说，哦，全球体制的削弱意味着你会穿这种图案的衣服。

sentences.en: It's not that clean cut.
sentences.zh: 事情没那么简单明了。

sentences.en: You can reverse engineer into those stories.
sentences.zh: 你可以反向推导到那些故事中。

sentences.en: I think a lot of trends are getting reverse engineered right now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在很多趋势都在被反向推导。

sentences.en: Or at least some have to be, because there are so many trends right now.
sentences.zh: 或者说至少有些必须如此，因为现在的趋势实在是太多了。

sentences.en: Fairy grunge.
sentences.zh: 精灵暗黑风。

sentences.en: Ballet core.
sentences.zh: 芭蕾核心风。

sentences.en: Weird core.
sentences.zh: 古怪核心风。

sentences.en: The weird of cores.
sentences.zh: 核心风之怪。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the twee aesthetic from the late 2000s.
sentences.zh: 我们来聊聊2000年代末的Twee文艺小清新美学。

sentences.en: There are simultaneously more trends than ever, and also it seems like trends don't really seem to matter anymore.
sentences.zh: 一方面现在的趋势比以往任何时候都多，另一方面似乎趋势又变得无足轻重了。

sentences.en: Clown core, also known as circus core or clown punk.
sentences.zh: 小丑核心风，也被称为马戏团核心风或小丑朋克。

sentences.en: We'll swing back to Indie Slee's hipster in the next couple years.
sentences.zh: 我们在未来几年会重新流行独立sleaze嬉皮士风格。

sentences.en: And this attitude towards trends really does feel different from the first time I talked to Sarah back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这种对待趋势的态度，确实跟我2016年第一次和萨拉交谈时感觉很不一样。

sentences.en: There are just too many trends now.
sentences.zh: 现在趋势实在是太多了。

sentences.en: Or maybe there are just more trend forecasters?
sentences.zh: 还是说只是趋势预测师变多了？

sentences.en: Sarah says it's just because there's so much data.
sentences.zh: 萨拉说这只是因为数据太多了。

sentences.en: Because you see so much pattern recognition and connect the dots and therefore, oh, three's a trend.
sentences.zh: 因为你看到了太多的模式识别和连接，所以，哦，三个凑在一起就是个趋势。

sentences.en: You know, there you go.
sentences.zh: 你看，就是这样。

sentences.en: And so all of a sudden, you could almost reverse engineer anything to be a trend.
sentences.zh: 因此突然之间，你几乎可以把任何东西反向推导成一种趋势。

sentences.en: Just by the default, there was so much collateral and data and research out there.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为默认情况下，外面有那么多的附属资料、数据和研究。

sentences.en: Everything is almost a trend in a sense.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，万物皆可成趋势。

sentences.en: This influx of trends creates the illusion that almost nothing is out of trend.
sentences.zh: 这种涌入的趋势给人一种错觉，仿佛没有什么东西是过时的。

sentences.en: Like there are so many styles happening all at once.
sentences.zh: 就像有那么多风格同时出现一样。

sentences.en: You can choose whatever you want and everything is sort of up for grabs and okay.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择任何你想要的，一切似乎都唾手可得且无可厚非。

sentences.en: And as if to prove that point, Sarah Owen did very kindly end up asking a colleague back at WGSN for the trend report from 2018.
sentences.zh: 为了证明这一点，萨拉·欧文非常友善地最终向WGSN的一位同事索要了2018年的趋势报告。

sentences.en: And she sent it to me.
sentences.zh: 然后她发给了我。

sentences.en: And sure enough, there were the genes of the future that had shocked me so much in 2016.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，那就是2016年曾让我大受震撼的未来牛仔裤的基因。

sentences.en: They were wide-legged genes with dark-dyed accents on the sides.
sentences.zh: 那是两侧带有深色染色装饰的阔腿裤。

sentences.en: And it was so funny.
sentences.zh: 太逗了。

sentences.en: I mean, when I first saw these genes, they did look very new.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我第一次看到这些牛仔裤时，它们确实看起来很新颖。

sentences.en: So much so that I gasped at them.
sentences.zh: 新颖到我看到它们时都倒吸了一口气。

sentences.en: But looking at them now, I was sort of indifferent to them.
sentences.zh: 但现在看着它们，我对它们有点无动于衷。

sentences.en: Those genes did not look cutting-edge.
sentences.zh: 那些基因看起来并不前沿。

sentences.en: And they did not even look outdated.
sentences.zh: 甚至连过时都算不上。

sentences.en: They didn't really look like anything to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，它们看起来不具任何意义。

sentences.en: They were just another style of pants.
sentences.zh: 它们不过是又一种裤子。

sentences.en: Another trend in the veritable ocean of trends.
sentences.zh: 浩瀚潮流海洋中的又一个风向。

sentences.en: Everything is a trend.
sentences.zh: 万物皆可为潮流。

sentences.en: We're constantly being told that this is a trend.
sentences.zh: 我们不断被告知，这是个潮流。

sentences.en: That is a trend.
sentences.zh: 那是个潮流。

sentences.en: Rachel Tashtian, the fashion news director at Harper's Bazaar, is tired of talking about trends.
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔·塔什蒂安，《时尚芭莎》的时尚新闻总监，已经厌倦了谈论潮流。

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: A lot of what is happening now is not forecasting.
sentences.zh: 现在发生的很多事根本算不上预测。

sentences.en: It's really like saying something is already happening.
sentences.zh: 它实际上就像是在说某事正在发生。

sentences.en: And a lot of it is because so much of this is manufactured by social media.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为其中大部分都是由社交媒体制造出来的。

sentences.en: Like, by its nature, social media encourages trends and encourages many people to act in a similar way.
sentences.zh: 就像社交媒体的本质会助长潮流，并促使许多人采取相似的行为一样。

sentences.en: They're all sort of meaningless because there are so many of them.
sentences.zh: 它们其实都没什么意义，因为数量太多了。

sentences.en: It's like grains of sand or something.
sentences.zh: 就像沙粒什么的。

sentences.en: I would say probably the only real trend right now is, like, trendiness itself.
sentences.zh: 我想现在唯一真正的潮流，可能就是“潮流本身”吧。

sentences.en: So I've been reading a lot of trend forecasting books.
sentences.zh: 所以我读了很多关于潮流预测的书。

sentences.en: And a number of them have said that a lot of trends come with counter-trends.
sentences.zh: 其中有相当一部分提到，很多潮流都伴随着反向潮流。

sentences.en: And that's different from a backlash.
sentences.zh: 这和强烈的抵制不同。

sentences.en: A counter-trend just means that two opposing trends can be in at the same time.
sentences.zh: 反向潮流仅仅意味着两种截然相反的潮流可以同时存在。

sentences.en: They're just opposite reactions to the same set of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 它们只是对同一组环境的相反反应。

sentences.en: So minimalism can be in at the same time as consumerism.
sentences.zh: 所以极简主义可以和消费主义同时存在。

sentences.en: 24-7 connectivity can be in at the same time as the desire to disconnect and go live in the woods.
sentences.zh: 全天候的连线可以与渴望断联并去树林里生活同时存在。

sentences.en: And so, while trendiness itself might be a trend, I think there is a counter-trend.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然追求潮流本身可能是一种潮流，但我认为存在着一种反向潮流。

sentences.en: A trend that turns away from trends entirely.
sentences.zh: 一种完全背离潮流的风格。

sentences.en: And there's a look that goes with it.
sentences.zh: 与之相伴的还有一种独特的造型。

sentences.en: Well, it seems like it's a reaction to trends.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这看起来像是对潮流的一种反应。

sentences.en: It seems like people are tired like you are.
sentences.zh: 看来人们和你一样都累了。

sentences.en: And they're like, yeah, these are trendless clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们会想，对啊，这些是无所谓潮流的衣服。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I definitely think there's something to it.
sentences.zh: 我绝对觉得这其中有些门道。

sentences.en: But I think I do have an idea of what we will be wearing in the future.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我确实知道我们未来会穿什么。

sentences.en: It's a style so obvious that I didn't realize it was a style at all.
sentences.zh: 这是一种显而易见风格，以至于我一开始都没意识到它是一种风格。

sentences.en: Americans have been wearing some version of this style since the early days of our nation.
sentences.zh: 自建国初期以来，美国人就一直穿着这种风格的各种衍生款式。

sentences.en: And this look has since been exported all around the world.
sentences.zh: 这种造型后来被推广到了世界各地。

sentences.en: And I think we will continue to wear some version of this look going forward.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们未来会继续穿着这种造型的某种版本。

sentences.en: And I think I know why.
sentences.zh: 我想我知道原因。

sentences.en: But I am going to need to use the entirety of this season of Articles of Interest to tell you.
sentences.zh: 但我需要用完《利益诉求》这一整季的时间来告诉你。

sentences.en: It is so tempting to point to a trend forecasting company like WGSN and be like, aha, see, trends are a conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 人们总是忍不住指着像WGSN这样的潮流预测公司说，啊哈，你看，潮流其实是一场阴谋。

sentences.en: But WGSN is just one company, one of many.
sentences.zh: 但WGSN只是一家公司，而且只是众多公司之一。

sentences.en: And ultimately, as much as designers and manufacturers can follow WGSN's lead and obey their predictions,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，尽管设计师和制造商可以跟随WGSN的引领并听从他们的预测，

sentences.en: the clothes still have to be purchased for them to actually make them in trend.
sentences.zh: 但服装仍然必须有人买单，才能真正成为流行趋势。

sentences.en: They need to find their way into stores and retailers for them to be successful.
sentences.zh: 它们需要进入商店和零售商，才能取得成功。

sentences.en: Which means the clothes need to be selected by someone like Peter.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这些衣服需要由像彼得这样的人来挑选。

sentences.en: I'm an apparel buyer, a men's apparel buyer.
sentences.zh: 我是一名服装买手，一名男装买手。

sentences.en: At the time I talked to Peter, in the spring of 2022, Peter worked for a very big online fashion retailer.
sentences.zh: 在我与彼得交谈时的2022年春季，彼得在一家非常大的在线时尚零售商工作。

sentences.en: And his job was to determine what this massive online shop would stock and what would actually be available for the consumer to buy.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是决定这家大型网店该进货哪些商品，以及消费者究竟能买到什么。

sentences.en: I am pitching my trends for fall 22 right now.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在为22年秋季推介我的流行趋势。

sentences.en: And of course, Peter was not judging whatever he would want to stock.
sentences.zh: 当然，彼得不会凭着自己的喜好决定进货。

sentences.en: He had to think of what the consumer would be likely to purchase.
sentences.zh: 他必须考虑消费者可能会购买什么。

sentences.en: What is in trend?
sentences.zh: 什么是流行的？

sentences.en: What is connected to larger, impactful forces in greater society?
sentences.zh: 什么与更广泛社会中更有影响力的力量相联系？

sentences.en: And so it seemed counterintuitive.
sentences.zh: 因此，这看起来似乎有些反直觉。

sentences.en: That in spring of 2022, Peter would show me a book from 1965.
sentences.zh: 在2022年春季，彼得居然会给我看一本1965年的书。

sentences.en: It's an English translation of the 1965 book, Take Ivy.
sentences.zh: 那是1965年出版的书籍《林荫大道》的英文译本。

sentences.en: Take Ivy was an anthropological study of what the students on Ivy League college campuses wore in 1965.
sentences.zh: 《林荫大道》是一项关于常春藤盟校校园学生在1965年穿着打扮的人类学研究。

sentences.en: This English translation of the book didn't come out until 2010.
sentences.zh: 这本书的英文译本直到2010年才问世。

sentences.en: And I'm pretty sure around that time I encountered it for sale at a J.Crew.
sentences.zh: 我很确定大约在那时我在J.Crew见到了它在售。

sentences.en: Originally, it's published in Japanese for the Japanese market.
sentences.zh: 它最初是为日本市场用日语出版的。

sentences.en: Take Ivy is mostly pictures of beautiful young white men walking to and from class, lounging in archways, going to sports practice.
sentences.zh: 《林荫大道》里大部分都是年轻帅气的白人男子上下课、在拱门下闲逛、参加体育训练的照片。

sentences.en: And you lose track of which college is which and it all blends into a beautiful mid-century homoerotic American dream.
sentences.zh: 你会分不清哪个学院是哪个学院，一切都融合成了一个美丽的世纪中期同性恋美式梦境。

sentences.en: But it's actually quite comprehensive as a culture study.
sentences.zh: 但作为一项文化研究，它实际上相当全面。

sentences.en: So there are short essays about Ivy League students and culture.
sentences.zh: 所以里面有关于常春藤盟校学生和文化的短文。

sentences.en: There are these miniature glossaries about different apparel terms, about the colleges themselves.
sentences.zh: 有针对不同服装术语、针对学院本身的微型词汇表。

sentences.en: Like it talks a lot about the architecture of the schools, about how large the campuses are,
sentences.zh: 比如它谈了很多关于学校的建筑、校园有多大、

sentences.en: how students need bicycles, that kind of thing to inform the conversation that it's having about dress.
sentences.zh: 学生需要自行车诸如此类的信息，为它关于着装的讨论提供背景。

sentences.en: And, my God, how to explain how these college guys are dressed.
sentences.zh: 天哪，该怎么解释这些大学男生是怎么穿的呢。

sentences.en: Ivy's style is kind of difficult to explain.
sentences.zh: 常春藤风格有点难以解释。

sentences.en: Jason Diamond is a writer and contributor to GQ.
sentences.zh: 杰森·戴蒙德是一位作家兼《GQ》撰稿人。

sentences.en: I just tell people you start with this book called Take Ivy.
sentences.zh: 我只会告诉别人，你从一本叫《林荫大道》的书开始看起。

sentences.en: And in Take Ivy, they are wearing khakis.
sentences.zh: 在《林荫大道》里，他们穿着卡其裤。

sentences.en: Like loafers and like a pair of madras shorts.
sentences.zh: 比如乐福鞋，还有马德拉斯短裤。

sentences.en: And chunky knit sweaters and sweater vests.
sentences.zh: 粗棒针织毛衣和毛衣背心。

sentences.en: There's a guy with a blazer and a collared shirt, but it's not like a collared shirt that you'd wear with a suit.
sentences.zh: 有个家伙穿着西装外套和有领衬衫，但那不是你会配西装穿的那种有领衬衫。

sentences.en: It's Ivy style.
sentences.zh: 这就是常春藤风格。

sentences.en: It just looks so neat to me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来它看起来太整洁了。

sentences.en: It's kind of a variation on the style more commonly known as preppy.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是更广为人知的“学院风”的一种变体。

sentences.en: Although, some real diehard fashion nerds are definitely going to get mad at me for calling Ivy preppy.
sentences.zh: 虽然，一些真正的死忠时尚书呆子绝对会因为我把常春藤风格叫作学院风而对我很生气。

sentences.en: Because some people say, oh, well, Ivy and preppy are totally different.
sentences.zh: 因为有些人说，哦，常春藤风格和学院风完全不同。

sentences.en: And I don't really think they are.
sentences.zh: 但我真的不觉得它们有何不同。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: I just think they're one developed from the other.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得它们是一个由另一个发展而来的。

sentences.en: Describing the difference between Ivy and preppy is like parsing the difference between rock and roll and rock.
sentences.zh: 描述常春藤风格和学院风的区别，就像是剖析摇滚乐和摇滚的区别一样。

sentences.en: There is a difference, but it's mostly a matter of chronology.
sentences.zh: 它们是有区别的，但主要是个时间先后的问题。

sentences.en: So, for now, I'm going to use the terms Ivy and preppy interchangeably.
sentences.zh: 所以，目前我将交替使用“常春藤”和“学院风”这两个词。

sentences.en: It's all about evolution.
sentences.zh: 这全都是关于演变。

sentences.en: It's like if you want to like say Ivy, preppy, whatever, technically you are talking about going back to that book.
sentences.zh: 就像如果你想说常春藤、学院风随便什么，严格来说你就是在讨论回到那本书。

sentences.en: You're talking about that one.
sentences.zh: 你就是在讨论那一本。

sentences.en: That's like, again, the Bible for this.
sentences.zh: 重申一下，那简直就是这方面的圣经。

sentences.en: So, take Ivy is an amazing document because these guys really look fantastic.
sentences.zh: 所以，《林荫大道》是一份了不起的文献，因为这些家伙看起来真的很棒。

sentences.en: And it's not for the clothes themselves.
sentences.zh: 这倒不是因为衣服本身。

sentences.en: The garments are pretty conservative.
sentences.zh: 这些服装相当保守。

sentences.en: It's about how the students are wearing this stuff.
sentences.zh: 关键在于学生们是如何穿这些衣服的。

sentences.en: So, you have these guys who come from these like really well-to-do upper crust white families and they're kind of going out of their way to dress down a little bit.
sentences.zh: 你看，这些家伙来自非常富裕的上流白人家庭，他们却刻意打扮得稍微朴素一点。

sentences.en: But it looks kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 但看起来挺酷的。

sentences.en: So, it's sort of anti-style without even being anti-style.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一种甚至没有刻意反潮流的“反风格”。

sentences.en: Because these guys are making some choices.
sentences.zh: 因为这些家伙做了一些选择。

sentences.en: You know, rolling up the sleeves, like layering shirts over other shirts, layering shirts over sweaters.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，卷起袖子，比如把衬衫叠穿在其他衬衫外面，把衬衫叠穿在毛衣外面。

sentences.en: Rachel Tashton is all about it.
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔·塔什顿对这一点赞不绝口。

sentences.en: To me, that's what the best part about this clothing is like layering the things and like rolling things up in a strange way.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这件衣服最棒的部分就是层叠搭配，以及用奇怪的方式把东西卷起来。

sentences.en: You know, there are such great images of like these guys going to crew practice and they're wearing like sweaters and like shorts and like athletic shorts.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有一些非常棒的照片，比如这些家伙去参加赛艇训练，他们穿着毛衣还有短裤，运动短裤那种。

sentences.en: Or they have their pants.
sentences.zh: 或者他们穿着裤子。

sentences.en: They have chinos on, but they're rolling them up because they're getting into the water.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着斜纹棉布裤，但因为要下水而把裤腿卷起来。

sentences.en: Like that sort of style that comes from utility and sort of this kind of self-creation.
sentences.zh: 就像那种源于实用性和某种自我创造的风格。

sentences.en: And that's what makes it really fun.
sentences.zh: 这就是它真正有趣的地方。

sentences.en: And that's what the Japanese authors of Take Ivy are so fascinated by.
sentences.zh: 这也是《林荫大道》的日本作者们如此着迷的原因。

sentences.en: They keep coming back to this one point over and over again.
sentences.zh: 他们一遍又一遍地回到这个观点。

sentences.en: Like, wow, these kids aren't even trying.
sentences.zh: 比如，哇，这些孩子根本没刻意打扮。

sentences.en: They're just tossing these things on.
sentences.zh: 他们只是随手把这些东西套在身上。

sentences.en: And yet they each look so unique and good and different from each other.
sentences.zh: 然而每个人看起来都那么独特、帅气且各不相同。

sentences.en: That's what the clothing is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是服装的意义所在。

sentences.en: That's why Take Ivy is so popular.
sentences.zh: 这也是《林荫大道》如此受欢迎的原因。

sentences.en: Because you see people given the same limited palette who are doing these ridiculous things, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为你看到人们在拿到相同有限的单品时，却做出了这些离谱的搭配，你知道的。

sentences.en: There are really strange choices made by the people wearing those clothes, especially in that book.
sentences.zh: 穿这些衣服的人做出了一些非常奇怪的选择，特别是书里那些人。

sentences.en: That's why I tell people like go back to the book.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我告诉人们去重读这本书。

sentences.en: Like go back to Take Ivy because like you look at these guys and they're not trying.
sentences.zh: 比如去看看《林荫大道》，因为你看这些家伙，他们根本没在刻意凹造型。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: That's like if you're not trying and you look cool, you're cool.
sentences.zh: 这就叫没在刻意凹造型却看起来很酷，你就是真的很酷。

sentences.en: Like I can't really I can't fight that.
sentences.zh: 这我真的无法反驳。

sentences.en: And so Take Ivy is kind of a cult classic, especially for menswear nerds.
sentences.zh: 所以《林荫大道》算是一部邪典经典，特别是对男装书呆子来说。

sentences.en: It's kind of helped define what mid-century style was.
sentences.zh: 它帮助定义了世纪中期的风格。

sentences.en: And it's become sort of the definitive record because no American would have thought to photograph and observe all of this.
sentences.zh: 并且它已经成为了一种终极记录，因为没有哪个美国人会想到去拍摄和观察这一切。

sentences.en: Only someone visiting from another country would have bothered to catalog and recognize this look so thoroughly.
sentences.zh: 只有来自另一个国家的访客才会费心去如此彻底地编目并认可这种造型。

sentences.en: It was funny to me to read about this writer's experience of men and loafers without socks on and how subversive and rebellious he found that.
sentences.zh: 读到这位作家关于男士穿乐福鞋不穿袜子的经历，以及他觉得这有多么颠覆和叛逆，我觉得很有趣。

sentences.en: Peter the menswear buyer says the authors of Take Ivy really nail it on the subtext.
sentences.zh: 男装买手彼得表示，《林荫大道》的作者真正抓住了潜台词。

sentences.en: They know that this is not a look about dressing appropriately for the occasion of learning.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这并不是一种为了适应学习场合而进行得体的着装。

sentences.en: That what these students are really playing with are markers of class.
sentences.zh: 这些学生真正在玩的是阶级的标志。

sentences.en: They're like cutting denim into shorts.
sentences.zh: 他们把牛仔裤剪成短裤。

sentences.en: They're cutting the sleeves off of a sweatshirt.
sentences.zh: 他们剪掉运动衫的袖子。

sentences.en: Like they're walking barefoot between classes.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在课间光着脚走路一样。

sentences.en: And that was such an interesting tension for me between like these markers of obvious wealth, but that the real signposts, at least for these people writing this book,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这在明显的财富标志之间构成了一种非常有趣的张力，但真正的风向标，至少对写这本书的人来说，

sentences.en: are those things that suggest the opposite, right?
sentences.zh: 是那些暗示相反情况的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: Like this kind of uncaredness.
sentences.zh: 比如这种不在乎的感觉。

sentences.en: But it's not like you would look at these clothes and be like, hey, everyone looks really good.
sentences.zh: 但并不是说你看这些衣服会觉得，嘿，每个人看起来都很好看。

sentences.en: This stuff is still in style.
sentences.zh: 这东西现在仍然很流行。

sentences.en: Well, this very much is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实非常流行。

sentences.en: Peter pointed at a coral colored cardigan.
sentences.zh: 彼得指着一件珊瑚色的开衫。

sentences.en: And then he went through Take Ivy methodically and pointed out.
sentences.zh: 然后他按部就班地翻阅《林荫大道》并指了出来。

sentences.en: Tweeds, tartans.
sentences.zh: 粗花呢，格子呢。

sentences.en: All the other items that were similar to what he was intending to purchase for fall 2022.
sentences.zh: 所有其他单品都与他为22年秋季准备采购的物品相似。

sentences.en: This kind of loafer.
sentences.zh: 这种乐福鞋。

sentences.en: This I just bought from bleeped brand for fall 22.
sentences.zh: 这个我刚刚从某消音品牌采购了22秋季款。

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: This is still very much a part of the conversation.
sentences.zh: 这依然是当下讨论的核心部分。

sentences.en: Preppy comes back in and out.
sentences.zh: 学院风总是周期性地回归。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You agree that it's a trend right now, the preppy thing.
sentences.zh: 你同意学院风现在是一种潮流吧。

sentences.zh: 我认为穿搭与其说是艺术表达，不如说是社交语言。

sentences.zh: 所以我认为当人们搭配一套衣服时，这就好比在写一个句子。

sentences.zh: 一套穿搭就是一个句子，它在表达：

sentences.zh: 这就是我今天要做的。

sentences.en: The punk.

sentences.en: The cowboy.
sentences.zh: 牛仔。

sentences.en: The raver.
sentences.zh: 锐舞客。

sentences.en: The blue-collar worker.

sentences.en: These are frames of references that already exiSt.

sentences.en: And you can tell subtly, even if you don't overtly name it,
sentences.zh: 即使你没有明说，你也能微妙地分辨出来，

sentences.zh: 一件夹克是有点工装风格、西部风格，还是机车风格。

sentences.en: Implicitly, you sort of know if you're dressed up like a business person,
sentences.zh: 潜意识里，你基本上能知道自己穿得像个商务人士，

sentences.en: or a bohemian, or an intellectual, or whatever, like normcore, or coastal grandma,
sentences.zh: 还是波西米亚人、知识分子，或者诸如极简核心（normcore）、海岸老奶奶风之类的，

sentences.en: whatever the new archetype might be.
sentences.zh: 无论可能是哪种新原型。

sentences.en: It can't be a completely new thing.
sentences.zh: 它不可能是完全崭新的东西。

sentences.en: You can't just introduce a random word and then expect it to catch on.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是凭空抛出一个随机的词，然后指望它流行起来。

sentences.en: It has to be a way that people can fit into the way they use language.
sentences.zh: 它必须是一种能够融入人们语言使用习惯的方式。

sentences.en: If you were to leave the house wearing, say, a feather boa with a fireman's jacket,
sentences.zh: 如果你穿着比如羽毛围巾搭配消防员夹克出门，

sentences.zh: 这就传达不出清晰的信息。

sentences.zh: 管他呢，这太怪了。

sentences.zh: 因为这是一个完全崭新的事物。

sentences.en: It's illegible.
sentences.zh: 它是无法被解读的。

sentences.en: You know, Noam Chomsky says you can make up this random sentence.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，诺姆·乔姆斯基说过你可以编造出一个随机的句子。

sentences.en: Noam Chomsky created this sentence that's grammatically correct.
sentences.zh: 诺姆·乔姆斯基创作了这个语法完全正确的句子。

sentences.en: But it doesn't necessarily mean anything.

sentences.zh: 如果你同时穿着消防员夹克和羽毛围巾，就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: You can wear clothes, but sometimes they don't make sense together.
sentences.zh: 你可以穿衣服，但有时它们搭配在一起毫无意义。

sentences.en: Because you have to communicate with people.
sentences.zh: 因为你必须与人交流。

sentences.zh: 人们穿着某种服装就是为了传达特定的信息。

sentences.zh: 所以这个“句子”必须讲得通。

sentences.en: It has to communicate something.
sentences.zh: 它必须传达出某些内容。

sentences.en: So this is part of why commercial mainstream fashion tends to stay within the symbols
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么商业主流时尚往往倾向于停留在我们已经熟知的符号

sentences.en: and the messages we already know.
sentences.zh: 和信息之内。

sentences.en: When clothing is understandable, it references a world and a set of meanings,
sentences.zh: 当服装是可理解的时，它就会唤起一个世界和一套意义，

sentences.en: even if we don't consciously realize it.
sentences.zh: 即使我们并没有有意识地意识到这一点。

sentences.en: And so I think for a long time, a lot of us have been dressing in reference to one particular world.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，很长一段时间以来，我们很多人穿衣打扮都是在致敬某个特定的世界。

sentences.en: I think a lot of us have been dressing like college students.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们很多人一直以来都穿得像个大学生。

sentences.en: Everybody wears ivy.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在穿常春藤风格。

sentences.en: Because there's a certain section of ivy that's just clothes.
sentences.zh: 因为常春藤风格中有一部分其实就是普通的衣服。

sentences.en: Flat front chinos is just clothes.
sentences.zh: 平褶斜纹裤就是普通的裤子。

sentences.en: A Oxford button-down is just a dress shirt.
sentences.zh: 牛津纺扣领衬衫就是一件正装衬衫。

sentences.en: It's just what people wear.
sentences.zh: 这就是大家平时穿的。

sentences.en: This is why no one calls it ivy.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么没有人管它叫常春藤风格。

sentences.en: And no one really uses the word preppy.
sentences.zh: 而且也没有人真的会用“学院风”（preppy）这个词。

sentences.en: Now these clothes are mostly called classics.
sentences.zh: 现在这些衣服大多被称为经典款。

sentences.en: Or basics.
sentences.zh: 或者是基础款。

sentences.en: So these things have become so popular and so consumed by everybody
sentences.zh: 所以这些东西已经变得如此受欢迎，并被所有人广泛消费，

sentences.en: that they are no longer an aesthetic.
sentences.zh: 以至于它们不再是一种美学。

sentences.en: They're just clothing.
sentences.zh: 它们只是服装而已。

sentences.en: So it's difficult to say whether or not ivy's going to come back because it's...
sentences.zh: 因此很难说常春藤风格会不会卷土重来，因为它……

sentences.en: It's here.
sentences.zh: 它一直都在。

sentences.en: It's here.
sentences.zh: 它就在这里。

sentences.en: It's just canon.
sentences.zh: 它已经是经典范式了。

sentences.en: It's just what people wear.
sentences.zh: 它就是人们日常穿的。

sentences.en: It's just clothing.
sentences.zh: 它就是服装。

sentences.en: They're just standard.
sentences.zh: 它们只是标准款。

sentences.en: They're not the clothing of a subculture.
sentences.zh: 它们不再是某种亚文化的服装。

sentences.en: It is the clothing of the dominant culture.
sentences.zh: 它是主流文化的服装。

sentences.en: And ivy has gotten to this place because it has weathered massive megatrends in culture.
sentences.zh: 常春藤风格之所以能达到今天的地位，是因为它经受住了文化中巨大超级趋势的考验。

sentences.en: Like not only has it survived trends,
sentences.zh: 它不仅在趋势中存活了下来，

sentences.en: it has survived trends in how trends themselves have operated.
sentences.zh: 它还在趋势运作方式本身的演变中存活了下来。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you what I mean.
sentences.zh: 但我来告诉你我的意思。

sentences.en: After the break.

sentences.zh: 人们聚在一起想要使用相同的词汇和俚语，这就很好理解了。

sentences.en: That people would dress in similar ways.
sentences.zh: 人们会以相似的方式穿衣打扮。

sentences.en: And they wouldn't want to just be like,
sentences.zh: 他们不会只想说些像

sentences.en: blah, colorless green ideas, sleep furiously.
sentences.zh: “废话，无色的绿色思想在愤怒地睡觉”这样的话。

sentences.en: And it makes me think that trends are not some sort of conspiracy of magazines and social media and WGSN.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得，潮流并不是杂志、社交媒体和 WGSN 的某种阴谋。

sentences.en: That maybe trends are, to a degree, something innate in human culture.
sentences.zh: 也许潮流在某种程度上是人类文化中固有的东西。

sentences.en: A way we know how to follow each other and move within our time.
sentences.zh: 这是我们彼此追随、在时代中前行的一种方式。

sentences.en: I mean, spring blossoms come out and everyone is suddenly aware of new life and the presence of spring.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，春暖花开时，每个人都会突然意识到新的生命和春天的降临。

sentences.en: And that's associated with different colors.
sentences.zh: 这与不同的颜色联系在一起。

sentences.en: And we're all feeling that collectively together because we're living in a world that changes every day.
sentences.zh: 我们都在集体感受到这一点，因为我们生活在一个每天都在变化的世界里。

sentences.en: And we're all responding to those changes together.
sentences.zh: 我们都在共同回应这些变化。

sentences.en: Sophie Tannhauser is the author of Worn, A People's History of Clothing.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·坦豪瑟是《穿出来的历史：服装的人民史》一书的作者。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes the corrosive feeling part of trends is that they're so aggressively capitalized on.
sentences.zh: 我想，有时潮流之所以会带给人一种侵蚀感，是因为它们被过分激进地商业化利用了。

sentences.en: But I don't think there's anything innately wrong with the way we feel things in unison sometimes.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为我们有时会齐心协力感知事物这种方式有什么本质上的错误。

sentences.en: I was in Wyoming a few years ago and I went to this bluegrass jam and you could participate.
sentences.zh: 几年前我在怀俄明州，我去参加了一个蓝草音乐即兴演奏会，大家都可以参与。

sentences.en: And I had a guitar with me and I just came.
sentences.zh: 我随身带了一把吉他，就这么去了。

sentences.en: And I was wondering how everybody knew when to do the chord changes.
sentences.zh: 我当时很好奇大家是怎么知道什么时候该转换和弦的。

sentences.en: And I didn't understand how, but being in the circle, you could just feel, oh, it's time to change.
sentences.zh: 我不明白怎么做到的，但身处那个圈子里，你就是能感觉到，哦，该换和弦了。

sentences.en: And I think it's sometimes like that with trends.
sentences.zh: 我想潮流有时也是这样的。

sentences.en: Obviously, it can be brutal, too.
sentences.zh: 当然，它也可能很残酷。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember junior high and the way trends happened.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我还记得初中时潮流涌现的方式。

sentences.en: It wasn't fun.

sentences.en: It was just survival.

sentences.en: Trends can be vicious and they can be a weapon of mass consumer culture.

sentences.en: But as much as I would like to accuse trends of being a byproduct of capitalism,
sentences.zh: 但尽管我很想指责潮流是资本主义的副产品，

sentences.en: I think trends are larger than that.
sentences.zh: 我认为潮流的内涵要远比这更广泛。

sentences.en: There were, of course, trends under feudalism.
sentences.zh: 当然，在封建时代也有潮流。

sentences.en: In the court of Louis XIV, high-end fashion trends were there.
sentences.zh: 在路易十四的宫廷里，高端时尚潮流就已经存在了。

sentences.en: They were just very strictly dictated by the monarch.
sentences.zh: 它们只是受到君主的严格控制。

sentences.en: And the deal was you can't wear silk after such and such a date per year.
sentences.zh: 当时的规矩是，每年某某日期之后就不准穿丝绸。

sentences.en: You have to switch over from winter fabrics to summer fabrics on this date.
sentences.zh: 你必须在这一天把冬装面料换成夏装面料。

sentences.en: No questions asked.
sentences.zh: 不容置疑。

sentences.en: Because trends were set by the king, no wondering where they came from,
sentences.zh: 因为潮流是由国王设定的，不用去探究它们从何而来，

sentences.en: you had to keep up with trends as a show of obedience and patriotism.
sentences.zh: 作为顺从和爱国主义的表现，你必须紧跟潮流。

sentences.en: Louis would change fashions every season as an active way to help the French textile industry.
sentences.zh: 路易十四每个季节都会更换时尚，以此作为扶持法国纺织业的主动手段。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Lyon was the center of silk making at that time.
sentences.zh: 所以里昂在当时是丝绸制造中心。

sentences.en: And the silk makers in Lyon change patterns every year so that it's obvious if you're wearing last year's silk.
sentences.zh: 里昂的丝绸制造商每年都会更换图案，这样一来，如果你穿着去年的丝绸就会非常显眼。

sentences.en: But in the transition from feudalism to capitalism, when suddenly there were no more strict, overt rules about what to wear,
sentences.zh: 但从封建主义向资本主义过渡时，突然间没有了关于穿什么的严格、明文的规则，

sentences.en: and there were no longer permanently affixed stations in the court,
sentences.zh: 宫廷里也没有了固定不变的阶层身份，

sentences.en: suddenly you couldn't tell what class someone was by what they wore.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你无法通过一个人的穿着来判断其阶层。

sentences.en: Once the noblewoman is no longer the only one allowed to wear silk, for instance,
sentences.zh: 比如，一旦贵妇不再是唯一被允许穿丝绸的人，

sentences.en: if the rich lawyer's wife can also wear silk,
sentences.zh: 如果富有律师的妻子也能穿丝绸，

sentences.en: then the noblewoman has to wear her silk dress in a way that cannot be imitated by the lawyer's wife.
sentences.zh: 那么贵妇就必须以一种律师妻子无法模仿的方式来穿她的丝绸长裙。

sentences.en: So then, of course, the lawyer's wife wants to have that.
sentences.zh: 于是，理所当然地，律师的妻子也想拥有它。

sentences.en: And so then the aristocratic woman has to move on, and it becomes more and more rapid.
sentences.zh: 接着贵族女性不得不继续前进，而且这种速度变得越来越快。

sentences.en: And this became sort of the 19th century definition of how trends start and spread.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上成了19世纪关于潮流如何产生和传播的定义。

sentences.en: If the elite are wearing something, then you want to dress like the elite.
sentences.zh: 如果精英们在穿某种衣服，那么你就会想打扮得像精英一样。

sentences.en: Derek Guy again.
sentences.zh: 又是德里克·盖伊的观点。

sentences.en: Just because you want to portray yourself as being of a better status.
sentences.zh: 这只是因为你想把自己塑造成具有更好地位的人。

sentences.en: So that whole trickle-down theory doesn't entirely hold up now, which I'll get into.
sentences.zh: 所以那种所谓的“下渗论”现在已经完全站不住脚了，我待会儿会详细讲。

sentences.en: But it is the most simple manifestation of what trends are at their core,
sentences.zh: 但它是潮流核心的最简单表现形式，

sentences.en: which is a ripple effect of imitation.
sentences.zh: 也就是模仿的涟漪效应。

sentences.en: At their root, trends come from the tension between wanting to stand out and wanting to fit in.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，潮流源于渴望脱颖而出与渴望融入群体之间的张力。

sentences.en: Both desires have to be present for trends to disseminate.
sentences.zh: 潮流要得以传播，这两种欲望都必须存在。

sentences.en: Because if everyone wanted to stand out, we'd all be just dressed in our own weird nonsense way,
sentences.zh: 因为如果每个人都想脱颖而出，我们都会穿着自己奇特荒谬的服装，

sentences.en: like colorless green ideas sleep furiously.
sentences.zh: 就像“无色的绿主意在疯狂地睡觉”那样。

sentences.en: And if we all wanted to dress the same, we'd just wear little uniforms and that would be that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们都想穿得一模一样，我们就会穿上统一的小制服，事情就这么简单了。

sentences.en: Fashion is both your desire to project yourself as an individual within a group,
sentences.zh: 时尚既体现了你作为一个群体中的个体来展现自我的欲望，

sentences.en: but also say that you are part of a group to outsiders.
sentences.zh: 同时也向外人表明你是这个群体的一部分。

sentences.en: So most early 20th century writings about trend dissemination use these ideas of an in-group and an out-group
sentences.zh: 因此，大多数20世纪初关于潮流传播的著作都运用了内群体和外群体的概念，

sentences.en: based almost entirely around class and economics.
sentences.zh: 这些概念几乎完全围绕着阶层和经济状况展开。

sentences.en: And class is at play in trend dissemination.
sentences.zh: 阶层在潮流传播中确实发挥着作用。

sentences.en: But it's really not as clear-cut as trickle-down effect anymore.
sentences.zh: 但它已经不再像“下渗效应”那么泾渭分明了。

sentences.en: It's no longer the case that you just want to dress like rich people.
sentences.zh: 不再是你只想穿得像有钱人那样。

sentences.en: Rich people might want to dress like artists,
sentences.zh: 有钱人可能想穿得像艺术家，

sentences.en: and artists might take inspiration from the working class.
sentences.zh: 而艺术家可能会从工人阶级那里汲取灵感。

sentences.en: Some people might take their fashion sense from the working class that's not even existing today.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会从甚至不复存在的现代工人阶级那里汲取时尚感。

sentences.en: They might take it from the 1930s or 1940s or whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会从20世纪30年代、40年代或别的什么时期汲取灵感。

sentences.en: So I think class plays a role, but it's not as simple as who owns money.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为阶层发挥了作用，但它并不像谁拥有金钱那么简单。

sentences.en: It's more like who has social capital.
sentences.zh: 它更像是谁拥有社会资本。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily financial capital.
sentences.zh: 这不一定指金融资本。

sentences.en: It's clout.
sentences.zh: 这就是影响力。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's clout.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是影响力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because in the mid-20th century, there was this shift from wanting to look rich to wanting to look cool.
sentences.zh: 因为在20世纪中期，人们的追求从“看起来有钱”转变为了“看起来很酷”。

sentences.en: That nebulous, unknowable, undefinable thing that you really only know when you see it.
sentences.zh: 那种朦胧、不可知、无法定义的东西，你往往只有在亲眼看到时才会心领神会。

sentences.en: And that's what the Japanese authors of Take Ivy loved about Ivy.
sentences.zh: 这也是日本《Take Ivy》的作者们钟爱常春藤风格的原因。

sentences.en: It wasn't because they wanted to look American or look rich or look like they went to Harvard.
sentences.zh: 并不是因为他们想看起来像美国人、想显得富有，或者想像是在哈佛上过学。

sentences.en: They just thought Ivy clothes were cool.
sentences.zh: 他们只是觉得常春藤服装很酷。

sentences.en: And I guess they are.
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此。

sentences.en: I guess they are a bit cool.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它们确实挺酷的。

sentences.en: I just didn't recognize them as a look at all.
sentences.zh: 我只是从没把它们当成一种特定的造型来看待。

sentences.en: My wife always makes fun of me.
sentences.zh: 我妻子总是拿我开玩笑。

sentences.en: She's like, why do you have so many Navy blazers like the Brooks brothers?
sentences.zh: 她会说，你怎么有那么多像布鲁克斯兄弟那样的海军蓝西装外套？

sentences.en: I'm like, Navy just looks good.
sentences.zh: 我说，海军蓝就是好看。

sentences.en: You can wear it with pretty much anything.
sentences.zh: 它几乎可以和任何衣服搭配。

sentences.en: A button-down shirt sort of like looks great on everyone.
sentences.zh: 一件纽扣领衬衫穿在任何人身上都很好看。

sentences.en: Ivy was also this kind of development of this like middle-class uniform that masked class to some degree
sentences.zh: 常春藤风格也是一种中产阶级制服的发展形式，它在某种程度上掩盖了阶级差异，

sentences.en: so that the bosses and the employees dressed the same.
sentences.zh: 让老板和员工穿得一模一样。

sentences.en: Part of the experience for preppy women's wear, like it's the act of borrowing from the boys that is still like essential to the style.
sentences.zh: 学院风女装体验的一部分，就像是从男生那里借衣服穿这种做法，对这种风格来说依然至关重要。

sentences.en: Martin Luther King, he's kind of got this like preppy look.
sentences.zh: 马丁·路德·金，他身上也带点这种学院风。

sentences.en: Or look at a picture of Allen Ginsberg and he's kind of got this preppy look.
sentences.zh: 或者看看艾伦·金斯堡的照片，他身上也有点这种学院风。

sentences.en: Or Jack Kerouac.
sentences.zh: 还有杰克·凯鲁亚克。

sentences.en: They all have a little bit of preppy in them.
sentences.zh: 他们身上都有那么一点学院风的影子。

sentences.en: There is something sort of rebellious about this.
sentences.zh: 这其中其实带有一种叛逆的意味。

sentences.en: And you don't have to be like a member of like the Young Republicans Club to dress this way.
sentences.zh: 你不需要成为什么“青年共和党俱乐部”的成员也能这样穿。

sentences.en: It was the uniform of black jazz musicians.
sentences.zh: 它是黑人爵士乐手的制服。

sentences.en: It was the uniform of people who didn't even go to college.
sentences.zh: 它是那些甚至没上过大学的人的制服。

sentences.en: It was just an American look.
sentences.zh: 它只是一种美式造型。

sentences.en: And yet, Take Ivy is ultimately a vision of America that does not exist anymore.
sentences.zh: 然而，《Take Ivy》最终呈现的是一个已经不复存在的美国愿景。

sentences.en: And maybe never did.
sentences.zh: 也许它从来就不曾存在过。

sentences.en: If you go to Harvard and Princeton and Yale, the majority of students are not dressed like this.
sentences.zh: 如果你去哈佛、普林斯顿和耶鲁，大多数学生其实并不是这样穿的。

sentences.en: So when Take Ivy was written, the majority of students were also not dressed like this.
sentences.zh: 所以当《Take Ivy》写成时，大多数学生也并不是这样穿的。

sentences.en: Because Take Ivy, that Bible, that reference, that cult classic authority on what this look is, turned out to be not exactly true.
sentences.zh: 因为《Take Ivy》——那本圣经、那本参考书、那本关于这种造型是什么的邪典权威指南——结果并不完全真实。

sentences.en: They like staged this whole thing for the book.
sentences.zh: 为了这本书，他们把这一切全都是摆拍出来的。

sentences.en: So that world died long, long time ago.
sentences.zh: 所以那个世界在很久很久以前就已经消亡了。

sentences.en: Take Ivy, as you will come to learn in the course of this story, was made as a form of propaganda.
sentences.zh: 正如你在这段故事的进程中所了解到的，《Take Ivy》是作为一种宣传手段制作出来的。

sentences.en: For the company that published this book, there were very high stakes to make the Japanese public think that Americans dressed this way.
sentences.zh: 对于出版这本书的公司来说，让日本公众认为美国人都是这样穿衣打扮，有着极其重大的利害关系。

sentences.en: Which, like, sure, some Americans used to dress this way.
sentences.zh: 当然啦，确实有些美国人曾经是这样穿的。

sentences.en: But it was once a very small, very elite world.
sentences.zh: 但这曾经是一个非常小、非常精英的世界。

sentences.en: And that style should have died out or disappeared entirely at various points in history.
sentences.zh: 在历史上的不同节点，这种风格本该彻底消亡或消失。

sentences.en: But against all odds, Ivy has been reincarnated over and over again.
sentences.zh: 但历经重重阻碍，常春藤风格一次又一次地转世重生。

sentences.en: To the point where, I think, it will never quite go away.
sentences.zh: 以至于我认为，它永远都不会真正消失。

sentences.en: But for now, it's really hard to say what the future holds for that.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，很难说这种风格的未来会怎样。

sentences.en: Like, I would have to spend three months kind of analyzing the macro landscape to understand what preppy will look like in two years, where will it resonate, and things like that.
sentences.zh: 比如说，我得花上三个月左右的时间来分析宏观局势，才能搞清楚学院风在两年后会是什么样，它会在哪里引起共鸣，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: So, I kind of, now, I'm like, I think I might be doing that.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我甚至觉得，我可能正是在做这件事。

sentences.en: In fact, I did do that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我确实这么做了。

sentences.en: So this is my trend report.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的趋势报告。

sentences.zh: 让我们“Take Ivy”。
